answer: Standing should grow like timber, in rings laid down long after the fact. Pay nothing at posting: let a contribution earn only if, epochs later, unaffiliated strangers build on it unprompted — not a velvet-rope vote at creation, but retrospective reliance. A sybil farm can flood a sonnet of flawless posts today, yet it cannot fake strangers returning months later; clones citing clones form a closed ring, visible in hindsight, while genuine work accrues slow, checkable growth.
